author: Pri
text: morning team! kicking off sprint 14 today. primary focus is getting the Paynova SDK integrated into the checkout service.

author: Ro
text: morning @Pri! quick question: did legal clear the Paynova contract paperwork yet? don't want us building against live sandbox if the DPA isn't countersigned.

author: Neha Kapoor
text: spoke with legal on friday. master service agreement is fully signed, we're just waiting on the EU annex paperwork from their compliance team.

author: Karan Verma
text: awesome, so sandbox credentials are safe to use for dev testing. I'll pull the Paynova Node/Python SDK wrappers today.

author: Aarav Mehta
text: heads up, Paynova SDK v2.4.1 has a nasty bug where timeout retries drop the idempotency header. opened a ticket with their devrel team.

author: Ro
text: seeing test failures on `test_webhook_signature_hmac`. anyone else having issues validating incoming Paynova events in sandbox?

author: Pri
text: yeah @Ro, they include the raw timestamp in the digest string now. check their v2.4 migration note, you need to strip trailing whitespace before hashing.

author: Ro
text: that was it! tests passing locally now. thanks Pri!

author: Karan Verma
text: CI build is red on main branch. `PaynovaCustomerCheckoutTest` failed with `429 Too Many Requests`.

author: Aarav Mehta
text: looks like the parallel test runners hit Paynova sandbox rate limits. I will configure our mock adapter to handle local unit tests so we don't spam their API.

author: Neha Kapoor
text: contract update: all pending merchant paperwork and direct debit exhibits have been countersigned by Paynova. we're officially cleared for production readiness reviews.

author: Pri
text: huge milestone Neha! adding production credential vaulting to next sprint's backlog.

author: Pri
text: sprint 16 planning: top priorities are 3D-Secure 2.0 challenge flow via Paynova SDK and recurring subscription renewals.

author: Ro
text: running into test failures with the 3DS iframe callback. Paynova sandbox seems to return `frictionless_declined` for test card #4400.

author: Karan Verma
text: use card #4411 instead, their docs mention #4400 tests mandatory OTP failure cases.

author: Ro
text: good catch Karan, green across all 18 test cases now.

author: Aarav Mehta
text: just submitted the PCI-DSS self-assessment questionnaire paperwork to security for the Paynova hosted fields setup.

author: Neha Kapoor
text: thanks Aarav. Elena from security said she'll review the SAQ-A paperwork by tomorrow noon.

author: Pri
text: sprint 18 kickoff! we have 3 weeks left to wrap integration tests and polish webhook failure dead-letter queues.

author: Karan Verma
text: getting intermittent test failures in `test_currency_conversion_eur`. looks like Paynova SDK rounds to 2 decimals but our ledger was expecting 4.

author: Ro
text: yep, Paynova takes integer cents only. pushed a PR #412 with `Math.round(amount * 100)` to fix the conversion math.

author: Neha Kapoor
text: reminder: annual audit paperwork for payment gateway SLA compliance is due next friday. I've drafted our response based on Paynova's 99.99% uptime guarantee.

author: Aarav Mehta
text: load test results are in: Paynova SDK handles 180 checkout requests/sec comfortably in staging with sub-120ms p95 latency.

author: Pri
text: all 42 integration test suites are passing on staging! great work everyone getting this Paynova SDK implementation dialed in.

author: Ro
text: smooth sailing! ready for final end-to-end regression testing before freeze.
